source_accounting_audit.verified_correction: Replace four-coordinate independent trunk_turn/trunk_flex S2 axes plus an orthogonality residual with one minimal three-coordinate right-handed trunk functional frame.

blocks.name: sensor_to_segment_longitudinal_axis
blocks.parameterization: 10 segments x S2 two-coordinate tangent chart

blocks.name: effective_relative_heading
blocks.parameterization: one yaw coordinate for every segment except pelvis
blocks.gauge: pelvis effective heading fixed to zero

blocks.name: limb_functional_axes
blocks.parameterization: 8 shoulder/elbow/hip/knee axes x S2 two-coordinate chart

blocks.name: trunk_functional_frame
blocks.parameterization: minimal SO3 rotation vector defining an orthonormal turn/flex/normal frame

blocks.name: joint_neutral_zero
blocks.parameterization: elbow L/R, hip L/R, knee L/R, trunk

blocks.name: static_latent_pose_reference
blocks.parameterization: initial_still and T-pose x 10 segments x S2 two-coordinate chart

frame_conventions.independent_q2_yaw: absorbed only through jointly estimated effective_relative_heading
frame_conventions.sensor_axis: board-frame unit vector; no axial twist coordinate
